partialText:
페이지네이션을 구현 후 페이지 맨 뒤를 찍고 돌아오면 중복되는 데이터가 생기는 버그를 발견했다.

.....

처음에는 순서에 문제가 생긴 줄 알았지만 콘솔을 확인해보니 같은 데이터가 또 렌더링 된다는 것이 확실해졌다.

딱 봤을 때는 어디가 문제고 어떻게 돌아가서 저렇게 렌더링 되는지 감도 잡히지 않아 계속 미뤄두었다.

처음에는 set을 사용하면 되지 않을까? 라는 생각을 했다. "중복을 제거한다" 에서 받아온 데이터를 set으로 한 번 정리해주는 방법밖에는 생각이 나질 않았다.

그런데 찾아보니 set은 객체에서는 set이 통하지 않는다는게 확인되었다.

그래서 왜 중복 렌더링이 되는 건지 원초적인 문제를 먼저 생각해보기로 했다. 나는 먼저 서버에서 데이터를 받아오고, 클라이언트에서 잘라서 보여주는 방법을 선택했기 때문에 다음과 같은 로직을 사용했다. 먼저 데이터를 불러온 후 setState 함수로 이전 (...prev)데이터와 새로 가져온 데이터를 붙여 넣었다. 지금 코드는 새로운 데이터를 검증없이 무조건적으로 이어 붙이기만 해서 생기는 문제였다. 해결하기 위해서는 set 대신 map 자료구조를 사용해야 했다. Map의 키는 중복을 허용하지 않으므로, 이미 존재하는 id가 다시 들어오면 덮어씌운다는 점을 이용한 코드이다. 

 setDashboardList((prev) => {
      const combined = [...prev, ...fetchdata.dashboards];

      const uniqueData = [
        ...new Map(
          combined.map((item: DashboardList) => [item.id, item])
        ).values(),
      ];
      return uniqueData;
    });

사실 filter나 findIndex를 통해서 렌더링 할 때 걸러내는 방식도 있었지만 렌더링 단계에서 불필요한 연산이 필요하므로 패스했다.

이에 대해서 더 찾아보니 렌더링 단계가 아닌 상태를 업데이트 할 때 직접 데이터의 무결성을 확보하는 것이 중요하다고 한다.

Communication is the foundation of everything we do. It’s how we share our feelings, ask for what we need, and build relationships with the people around us. However, for many children and adults, speaking or understanding language isn’t always easy. This is where speech language therapy comes in. In this post, we will explore what speech therapy is, who it helps, and what you can expect when you visit a professional clinic.

What is Speech Language Therapy? Speech-language therapy is a healthcare service provided by Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs). These experts are trained to help people with a wide variety of communication and swallowing disorders. While many people think speech therapy is only about "fixing a lisp," it actually covers much more. It involves: Speech Production: Helping people make sounds correctly so others can understand them. Language Expression: Helping people put words together to share ideas. Language Comprehension: Helping people understand what others are saying. Social Communication: Teaching the "unspoken rules" of conversation, like taking turns or staying on topic. Cognitive Communication: Improving memory, problem-solving, and organization skills.

Who Needs Speech Therapy? Speech therapy is not just for toddlers who are "late talkers." It is a valuable resource for people of all ages. For Children Many children visit a speech therapy clinic in Oakville to help with developmental delays. Early intervention is key. If a child struggles to express themselves, they may become frustrated, which can lead to behavioral issues. Therapy helps children succeed in school and build friendships. For Adults Adults may need therapy after a medical event, such as a stroke or a brain injury. Conditions like Parkinson’s disease or ALS can also affect speech and swallowing. In these cases, therapy focuses on regaining lost skills or finding new ways to communicate effectively.

Common Challenges Treated in Oakville At Butterfly Therapy Oakville, therapists work with a variety of conditions. Some of the most common include: Articulation Disorders: When a person has trouble saying specific sounds (like the "s" or "r" sound). Fluency Disorders (Stuttering): When the flow of speech is interrupted by repetitions or long pauses. Gestalt Language Processing: A different way of learning language where children learn in "chunks" or phrases rather than single words. Apraxia of Speech: A neurological condition where the brain struggles to tell the mouth muscles how to move to make sounds. Aphasia: Difficulty speaking or understanding language due to brain damage.

Why Choose a Private Speech Therapy Clinic in Oakville? Choosing the right clinic is a big decision for any family. Many parents prefer a private clinic like Butterfly Therapy Oakville because it offers a personalized, multidisciplinary approach. When you visit a specialized clinic, you aren't just getting a therapist; you are getting a partner in your child's development. Private clinics often have shorter wait times than public programs and can offer more frequent sessions, which can lead to faster progress.

What to Expect During Your First Visit If you are nervous about your first appointment, don't be! Most clinics aim to make the environment feel like a "home away from home." The Assessment The first step is always an assessment. This is a 1-hour session where the therapist gets to know the client. They will use games, pictures, and conversations to see where the strengths and challenges lie. For children, this usually feels like playtime. The Treatment Plan After the assessment, the therapist will create a custom plan. This plan includes specific goals, such as "Learning to say the 'k' sound" or "Using 3-word sentences." Fun and Engaging Sessions In a pediatric setting, therapy is designed to be fun. If a child is having a good time, they are more likely to learn. Therapists use toys, books, and digital tools to keep engagement high.

The Role of the Family One of the most important parts of speech therapy is what happens outside the clinic. At Butterfly Therapy Oakville, parents are viewed as the primary advocates for their children. Therapists often provide "homework" or simple games to play at home. This ensures that the skills learned in the clinic are used in everyday life. When families are involved, the progress is often much more sustainable. Consistency is Key: Attending sessions regularly helps build momentum. Practice at Home: 10 minutes of daily practice is often better than one long session once a week. Positive Reinforcement: Celebrating small wins builds the client's confidence.

How to Get Started If you have concerns about your communication or your child’s development, the best thing you can do is seek a professional opinion.
